scope: Opt-in bounded R13/R14 TABLE grid observation with unchanged legacy 2D callback and raw source retention; no complete cells or output profile.

authority.document: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
authority.fields: TABLE value flag, horizontal direction, column and row counts, BD column widths and row heights, and hard-pointer TABLESTYLE.

source.provenance: Project sample script uses AutoCAD SAVEAS LT98; exact producing build and original source provenance remain unverified. External file is not committed.
source.peer: GNU LibreDWG 0.14 independently reports TABLE 0x528 as 3 columns by 7 rows, TABLE 0xA35 as 5 columns by 4 rows, TABLESTYLE 0x87 and the width and height values asserted by the hash-selected test.

implementation.contract: A separate DRW_DwgLegacyTableGridHandler opt-in leaves the DRW_Interface vtable unchanged. Only the opt-in pays to parse and retain the grid. Normal addTable receives the incomplete INSERT-like prefix with no grid and one row/column repetition; the side callback receives the bounded grid with semantic completeness false. The original raw peer stays unvalidated.
implementation.transaction: Unknown flags, empty or oversized grids, invalid style roles, non-finite dimensions or truncated optional grid leave only the prior INSERT prefix; corrected input retries successfully. Direct encoding of an incomplete grid refuses without altering destination buffers.
implementation.sharedCode: The version-aware bounded grid routine is shared with the existing AC1015-AC1021 table path.

validation.external: The hash-selected external CTest checks no-handler, handler-disabled and handler-enabled paths; each preserves normal 2D projection and raw peers. Only enabled handlers receive both grids, with all peer widths/heights and style target.
validation.asan: Both generated malformed/failure/retry controls and the opt-in external control passed with AddressSanitizer.
validation.modern: Rebuilt AC1018/AC1021 TABLE cell reader including allocation rollback/retry, AC1021/AC1024 placement and AC1024 merged-range vectors passed.
validation.remaining: The grids do not include validated cells; native TABLE render/output and legacy ATTRIB chains remain unqualified. This sample has four unrelated object parse failures and unsupported custom objects.
validation.focused: Six rebuilt legacy source/prefix, 2D callback order, proxy-graphics, runtime fallback and DXF TABLE-content tests passed.
validation.guard: Strict and partial ASCII/Binary conversion still refuse the R14 sample at the unqualified IMAGEDEF owner gate and preserve destination bytes.

consumerFollowUp: The modern TABLE body parser assigns grid dimensions to DRW_Insert rowcount/colcount, and LibreCAD addTable forwards the same record to addInsert, which uses those fields as array repetition counts. Verify actual rendering and fix the newer-source path without losing table dimensions or codec roundtrip; it is separate from this bounded legacy path.
